prose: Vibe Rant's own court astrologer, Kayleigh Berkana, returns to hang out and share some of the sky-clock knowledge & skills she's been developing since her last visit. We'll look at some of the recent events that have turned the world on its ear, through the astrology lens, along with what type of vibe climate we can expect for the coming months.
